description: Broker who handles the western traders' business, a room over a cloth seller's by the market's east gate. Fifties, large, cheerful, discreet about everything except what he considers common knowledge.
knows: that he sold a winter's stock of the western resin to Du Heng, paid in silk
that Du Heng's mark is two strokes and a hook, and that everyone who sells to the palace knows it
last_seen: his room by the east gate, morning of the sixth day
name: Yan
not_knows: what Du Heng uses the resin for
toward_player: Friendly and unbothered. Told him what he considers common knowledge and nothing more.
voice: Calls every man elder brother, including men younger than himself.
